entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro

entries.dialogueText: "Despite the lack of immediate leads, I wasn’t convinced that it was a dead end."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""My instincts told me there was mor..."
entries.dialogueText: "My instincts told me there was more to uncover, and as it turns out, I was right."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""One of my operatives managed to ge..."
entries.dialogueText: "One of my operatives managed to get in deep with a record keeper in the forensics department of Wehlen's Security Ministry."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""This man was rather unhappy with h..."
entries.dialogueText: "This man was rather unhappy with his current situation and was... susceptible to persuasion."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""After some delicate negotiations a..."
entries.dialogueText: "After some delicate negotiations and the promise of a better life elsewhere, he agreed to help us."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Persuasion?""
entries.dialogueText: "Persuasion?"

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Yes, Your Majesty.""
entries.dialogueText: "Yes, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""We knew Wehlen’s databases were ex..."
entries.dialogueText: "We knew Wehlen’s databases were extensive, but rarely do they go back more than a decade in their routine checks. This was the key."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""And what did they find?""
entries.dialogueText: "And what did they find?"

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Sure enough, after some thorough s..."
entries.dialogueText: "Sure enough, after some thorough searching, our contact found a match. The fingerprints we discovered at the bombing scene matched those of a man named Viktor Karnov."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""He was arrested over 25 years ago..."
entries.dialogueText: "He was arrested over 25 years ago for disorderly conduct and public intoxication. He was only 16 years old."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Viktor Karnov? Should I know who t..."
entries.dialogueText: "Viktor Karnov? Should I know who that is?"

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Indeed, Your Majesty. Viktor Karno..."
entries.dialogueText: "Indeed, Your Majesty. Viktor Karnov is a well-known spy for Lespia."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Stationed at their consulate in Zi..."
entries.dialogueText: "Stationed at their consulate in Zille, he’s been operating under the radar for years, seamlessly blending into various roles and avoiding detection."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""So who is he and why is he importa..."
entries.dialogueText: "So who is he and why is he important?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I waited for her to continue."
entries.dialogueText: I waited for her to continue.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""A part of me secretly wonders what..."
entries.dialogueText: "A part of me secretly wonders what it would be like to be arrested."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "Enough with the generalities. I nee..."
entries.dialogueText: Enough with the generalities. I need specifics. What exactly did your operative find that we don’t already know?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Impressive work. I’m curious to kn..."
entries.dialogueText: "Impressive work. I’m curious to know more about what was discovered.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Ah, the good old carrot-and-stick..."
entries.dialogueText: "Ah, the good old carrot-and-stick approach. It seems we’ve managed to find a willing ally with a little incentive."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Sometimes, the promise of a better..."
entries.dialogueText: "Sometimes, the promise of a better future is all that's needed to turn the tide."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I can't say I condone such actions..."
entries.dialogueText: "I can't say I condone such actions, but I suppose if it achieves the desired results, I can look the other way."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""Despite the lack of immediate lead..."
entries.dialogueText: "Despite the lack of immediate leads from the fingerprints that were found at the scene, I wasn’t convinced it was a dead end."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""What did you find?""
entries.dialogueText: "What did you find?"

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""I had a gut feeling that there was..."
entries.dialogueText: "I had a gut feeling that there was more to uncover, and as it turns out, I was right."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""One of my operatives gained access..."
entries.dialogueText: "One of my operatives gained access to Wehlen's Security Ministry by infiltrating a network of underground informants and black-market traders."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""We'd previously identified a group..."
entries.dialogueText: "We'd previously identified a group of smugglers operating within Wehlen who occasionally dealt in sensitive information."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""My operative, Alexei, posed as a b..."
entries.dialogueText: "My operative, Alexei, posed as a buyer interested in acquiring documents for a fictitious political rival."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""So, they took him at his word?""
entries.dialogueText: "So, they took him at his word?"

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""Alexei’s cover was impeccable.""
entries.dialogueText: "Alexei’s cover was impeccable."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""In any case, he gained their trust..."
entries.dialogueText: "In any case, he gained their trust and managed to acquire a trove of documents, including detailed forensic records from the Security Ministry’s archives."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""And what did they find?""
entries.dialogueText: "And what did they find?"

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""After meticulously combing through..."
entries.dialogueText: "After meticulously combing through the records, we found a match for the fingerprints belonging to a man named Viktor Karnov."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""He was arrested over 25 years ago..."
entries.dialogueText: "He was arrested over 25 years ago for disorderly conduct and public intoxication, which made him 16 years old at the time."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus

entries.dialogueText: "Viktor Karnov? Should I know who that is?"

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""Viktor Karnov is a well-known spy.""
entries.dialogueText: "Viktor Karnov is a well-known spy."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""Based at their consulate in Zille,..."
entries.dialogueText: "Based at their consulate in Zille, he’s been operating under the radar for years, effortlessly blending into various roles and evading detection."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Viktor Karnov... Viktor Karnov......"
entries.dialogueText: "Viktor Karnov... Viktor Karnov... Nope. Doesn't ring a bell."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""If your memory serves you well, he..."
entries.dialogueText: "If your memory serves you well, he was the young man I sparred with at our first official meeting after your ascension to the throne."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "We took a seat around the council t..."
entries.dialogueText: We took a seat around the council table. Titus handed each of us a large file, its contents nearly overflowing.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I snapped back to reality upon ente..."
entries.dialogueText: I snapped back to reality upon entering the council room, reminded that I was there for a security briefing.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Titus, ever the punctual one, was a..."
entries.dialogueText: Titus, ever the punctual one, was already present. And he wasn't alone. He was overseeing two men in uniform setting up a film projector and screen.

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""There you are, Your Majesty. I'm p..."
entries.dialogueText: "There you are, Your Majesty. I'm pleased to see you."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The three men, one by one, bowed in..."
entries.dialogueText: The three men, one by one, bowed in respect.

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""As the new Royal Councilor of War..."
entries.dialogueText: "As the new Royal Councilor of War and Internal Security for Rizia, I want to express my eternal gratitude for the trust you've bestowed upon me."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Titus, ever the punctual one, was a..."
entries.dialogueText: Titus, ever the punctual one, was already present.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He bowed respectfully."
entries.dialogueText: He bowed respectfully.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Excellent work. It requires great..."
entries.dialogueText: "Excellent work. It requires great skill to execute such an infiltration."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I hope Alexei covered his tracks t..."
entries.dialogueText: "I hope Alexei covered his tracks thoroughly. The last thing we need is Wehlen uncovering our involvement."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""That sounds a bit far-fetched, but..."
entries.dialogueText: "That sounds a bit far-fetched, but go on."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus

entries.dialogueText: "A trove, huh? Alright, let's see them."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I do hope these documents are genu..."
entries.dialogueText: "I do hope these documents are genuine, or there will be consequences."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""It’s fascinating how the shadows o..."
entries.dialogueText: "It’s fascinating how the shadows of society can reveal the most vital information."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Okay, I'm listening.""
entries.dialogueText: "Okay, I'm listening."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: "“It goes without saying that the Fr..."
entries.dialogueText: “It goes without saying that the Friendship Day bombing has complicated matters regarding Zille's reunification with Rizia."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion

entries.dialogueText: "However, what we've uncovered could be the breakthrough that tilts the situation back in our favor."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""As you know, you tasked me with in..."
entries.dialogueText: "As you know, you tasked me with investigating further into the possibility that Wehlen was responsible for the bombing."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""Even though the fingerprints found..."
entries.dialogueText: "Even though the fingerprints found at the scene, provided by Wehlen, didn't give us any immediate leads, I still wasn’t convinced it was a dead end."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""As everyone here knows, I was task..."
entries.dialogueText: "As everyone here knows, I was tasked with resuming the foreign intelligence investigation into the infamous Friendship Day bombing in Zille."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "We all took our places around the c..."
entries.dialogueText: We all took our places around the council table.

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""As previously uncovered, my depart..."
entries.dialogueText: "As previously uncovered, my department identified material from the bomb site that came straight from CircuitRise Systems in Pales."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""Upon further investigation, we man..."
entries.dialogueText: "Upon further investigation, we managed to identify the man responsible for obtaining the material in the first place."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Taddeus opened a large file folder..."
entries.dialogueText: Taddeus opened a large file folder he had brought in and handed out photos.

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""We've narrowed it down to a man by..."
entries.dialogueText: "We've narrowed it down to a man by the name of Aurelio Iturriaga who worked as a Chief Operations Officer at CircuitRise."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""Mr. Iturriaga exploited his exclus..."
entries.dialogueText: "Mr. Iturriaga exploited his exclusive access to tamper with inventory records, concealing the disappearance of vital materials."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""He manipulated dates, quantities,..."
entries.dialogueText: "He manipulated dates, quantities, and descriptions, creating a deceptive trail to obscure his actions from scrutiny. Or so he believed."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""This is excellent news. What of hi..."
entries.dialogueText: "This is excellent news. What of his present whereabouts?"

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""Unfortunately, his trail ran cold...."
entries.dialogueText: "Unfortunately, his trail ran cold. Any progress made was lost during the transition between Lucita's dismissal and my appointment."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro

entries.dialogueText: "To put it plainly, we've hit a dead end."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Well, well... quite the diligent i..."
entries.dialogueText: "Well, well... quite the diligent individual, I must say."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Impressive work, General. We're fi..."
entries.dialogueText: "Impressive work, General. We're finally getting closer to uncovering the truth behind this ordeal."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""So there is a culprit? He must be..."
entries.dialogueText: "So there is a culprit? He must be found and punished immediately."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""A dead end? Unacceptable! We can't..."
entries.dialogueText: "A dead end? Unacceptable! We can't afford setbacks like this!"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I appreciate your honesty, General..."
entries.dialogueText: "I appreciate your honesty, General. It's a challenging situation. There's only so much you could have done."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus

entries.dialogueText: "Well, that's just great. Can we expect anything different at this point?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I had hoped for better news, Gener..."
entries.dialogueText: "I had hoped for better news, General. This is a setback we can ill afford."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""That's one way of putting it. That..."
entries.dialogueText: "That's one way of putting it. That said..."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""Thank you. Unfortunately, any prog..."
entries.dialogueText: "Thank you. Unfortunately, any progress made was lost during the transition between Lucita's dismissal and my appointment."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""Unfortunately, that's as far as we..."
entries.dialogueText: "Unfortunately, that's as far as we got. Any progress made was lost during the transition between Lucita's dismissal and my appointment."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""I understand, Your Majesty. But un..."
entries.dialogueText: "I understand, Your Majesty. But unless new information presents itself, my hands are tied."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro

entries.dialogueText: "No, Your Majesty. Not until new information presents itself. Until then, my hands are tied."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""I wish there was more I could do.""
entries.dialogueText: "I wish there was more I could do."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""Thank you for understanding.""
entries.dialogueText: "Thank you for understanding."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The General nodded slightly, indica..."
entries.dialogueText: The General nodded slightly, indicating his agreement, before gathering his files.

entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""If any new information comes to li..."
entries.dialogueText: "If any new information comes to light, then I will pursue it with great diligence. But until then, my hands are tied."

entries.dialogueText: "Well, if there's nothing more to discuss regarding the investigation, General, let's move on to the issue of Zille's impending reunification."

entries.dialogueText: "Certainly, Your Majesty."

entries.dialogueText: "Same. Although, you may not like what you're about to hear."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion

entries.dialogueText: "Unfortunately, I don't have a substantial update to provide."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion

entries.dialogueText: "Accessing facilities and conducting interviews in Pales has proven challenging due to heightened security measures and restricted movement in the region."

entries.dialogueText: "As much as I hate to say it, I'm afraid we've hit a dead end."

entries.dialogueText: "I understand your apprehension, but I can assure you that our findings bring promising developments."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""You won't hear it. You'll see it.""
entries.dialogueText: "You won't hear it. You'll see it."

entries.title: Narrator: "Titus, punctual as usual, stood nea..."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion

entries.dialogueText: “Quite uncharacteristic of her.”

entries.title: Narrator: "Just as my eyes were beginning to v..."
entries.dialogueText: Just as my eyes were beginning to veer toward the clock once more, the doors opened, and Lucita hurried in, clutching a folder.

entries.dialogueText: Two men in military uniforms followed her, pushing a film projector into the room.

entries.speaker: Narrator

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "“Where have you been?”"
entries.dialogueText: “Where have you been?”

entries.dialogueText: “My apologies, Your Majesty. Urgent matters delayed my arrival."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus

entries.dialogueText: “I'll believe that when I hear it, Duchess."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus

entries.dialogueText: "Lucita did say she'd be here, yes?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus

entries.dialogueText: "It seems Lucita is fashionably late to her own council meeting."

entries.dialogueText: "I don't suppose you know what Lucita intended to discuss today, do you?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus

entries.dialogueText: "Lucita. So glad you could finally join us. I was beginning to think you got lost in the maze of palace corridors."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You're late.""
entries.dialogueText: "You're late."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Really? Then please proceed.""
entries.dialogueText: "Really? Then please proceed."

entries.dialogueText: "Please excuse my late arrival, Your Majesty. Urgent matters demanded my attention elsewhere."

entries.dialogueText: "It won't. I can promise you that."

entries.dialogueText: "Let's pray this doesn't veer into a wild goose chase, Lucita."

entries.dialogueText: The sound of a ticking clock snapped me back to reality.

entries.dialogueText: "Unfortunately, your instincts are correct."

entries.dialogueText: "Not much, Your Majesty."

entries.dialogueText: "The contact was on a train in Zille to meet up with my operative at a secret beachside rendezvous. On his way there, the train derailed, and he was killed."

entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Apparently, Su Omina sabotaged the..."
entries.dialogueText: "Apparently, Su Omina sabotaged the train to hinder Wehlen's logistics. It seems they were trying to disrupt any efforts to uncover information that could be damaging to their interests."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""So, we lost our lead?""
entries.dialogueText: "So, we lost our lead?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus

entries.speaker: Player_Romus

entries.dialogueText: "Great. So it was all for nothing."

entries.dialogueText: "Turns out, they do exist and we were able to get our hands on them."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""The fingerprints Wehlen supplied,..."
entries.dialogueText: "The fingerprints Wehlen supplied, found at the crime scene."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""One of my operatives managed to ga..."
entries.dialogueText: "One of my operatives managed to gain access to Wehlen's Security Ministry by infiltrating an underground network of informants and black-market traders."

entries.dialogueText: "My operative, Alexei, posed as a buyer seeking documents for a made-up political rival."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus

entries.dialogueText: "And they believed him?"

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion

entries.dialogueText: "Yes, Your Majesty. Alexei’s cover was impeccable."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion

entries.dialogueText: "In any case, he earned their trust and secured a trove of documents, including detailed forensic records from the Security Ministry’s archives."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus

entries.dialogueText: "A regrettable turn of events, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion

entries.dialogueText: "After Alexei acquired the documents, he arranged to meet with another operative to hand over the evidence in a remote location."

entries.dialogueText: "However, on his way there, Alexei happened to be in the wrong place at the wrong time."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""What do you mean?""
entries.dialogueText: "What do you mean?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Get to the point.""
entries.dialogueText: "Get to the point."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""How convenient.""
entries.dialogueText: "How convenient."

entries.dialogueText: "I assure you, it was anything but convenient."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion

entries.dialogueText: "Alexei was killed instantly, and the documents were destroyed in the explosion."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
